meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. You said "your son cheated" with a score and nothing else, and I'm writing that down. Are you calling me a liar too?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because I'm questioning your evidence. I'm writing that down, word for word. Under your own procedure, 4.5 is for repeated concerns, so show me where this is one, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, nothing on Owen's record, and she is heading to the principal's office.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it was an accusation with no document behind it, and it made her defend Owen and turn on you.
Try next time: when she asks what else you have, skip the detector score, own in one sentence that the zero was entered before anyone called her, and bring a dated document about Owen's own process.
